name: jinshuju
description: 用自然语言在金数据（jinshuju.net）上搭建表单与数据表格：创建、复制、编辑表单与主题，建表加列，批量增删改查数据，查询账户套餐与团队成员，替代登录后台手动操作。
descriptionEn: Build forms and tables on Jinshuju (jinshuju.net) with natural language: create, copy, and edit forms and themes, manage table columns, batch create/update/query/delete entries, and check plan quota and team members — no dashboard login needed.
